purpose: Topic-specific creative director taxonomy: unique four-scene editorial concepts, localized RU/EN/ES; verified footage remains separately governed

rules.subcategoryChoicePolicy: Classify by the primary need. Low energy, fatigue and rest or sleep belong to Energy & Confidence → Fatigue & Recovery. Long-term overload and burnout belong to Stress & Anxiety → Stress & Burnout. Relationship-specific worry belongs to Love & Relationships; anxiety that exists across situations belongs to Stress & Anxiety.

classificationPrinciples: Classify each topic by the user's primary need; related words are search synonyms or tags, not duplicate placements.
Money worry belongs to Goals & Money → Money & Abundance when money is the trigger; general anxiety belongs to Stress & Anxiety → Anxiety & Fears.
Low energy, physical or mental fatigue and sleep or rest belong to Energy & Confidence → Fatigue & Recovery; prolonged overload and burnout belong to Stress & Anxiety → Stress & Burnout.
Self-confidence and self-esteem belong to Energy & Confidence → Confidence & Calm. Fear of a specific situation belongs to Stress & Anxiety → Anxiety & Fears.
Relationship-specific fears belong to Love & Relationships when the issue is closeness, a partner or a breakup; generalized worry belongs to Stress & Anxiety.
Childhood experiences, rejection and abandonment belong to Stress & Anxiety → Psychological Trauma; persistent low mood, apathy and loss of joy belong to Depression & Apathy.

scenarioArchetypes.brief: Show a topic-specific journey from the current situation to a realistic next step.
Build a calm story around safety, resources and a sense of choice.
Use a distinct metaphor to explore the topic from another angle.
End with one small, optional action grounded in everyday life.
